facts.title: Blueberry Almond Crisp
ingredients: 2 pounds blueberries (that’s 32 ounces, which is about 5 cups or a little less than 3 pints), fresh or frozen*
⅓ cup maple syrup or honey
2 tablespoons arrowroot starch or 3 tablespoons cornstarch
1 cup old-fashioned oats (certified gluten-free for a gluten-free crisp)
½ cup packed almond meal or almond flour
⅓ cup lightly packed brown sugar
3 tablespoons plain yogurt (Greek or regular), or additional melted butter
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
